rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Saturn, source line 1
rules.historical_meaning_only: A well-affected Saturn returning to its own natal place signifies dignity, property gain, and possibly inheritance.
source_conditional_qualifiers: Requires Saturn to be well affected in the revolution; the claim of dignity is greater if Saturn is in the midheaven.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Jupiter, source line 2
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn reaching Jupiter's natal place is associated with advantages in the body and property.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Mars, source line 3
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source associates Saturn at natal Mars with travel, dishonesty, and adversity to siblings.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Sun, source line 4
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn at the natal Sun is associated with disputes with powerful people, housing losses and bodily or eyesight troubles.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Venus, source line 5
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source presents a gendered allegation of limited sexual desire/potency together with visiting sex workers.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Mercury, source line 6
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn at the natal Mercury is associated with mental perplexity and trouble concerning words, writing or children.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Saturn: returning to radix place Moon, source line 7
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn at the natal Moon is said to threaten death and melancholy, bodily humoral troubles, coughs and an unfavorable wife.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Jupiter, source line 1
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter returning to its natal position is said to promise a child, wealth, health and esteem.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Saturn, source line 2
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter at Saturn's natal place is interpreted as increasing or decreasing Saturn's natal indications.
source_conditional_qualifiers: If Saturn's radix significance was good, it is augmented; if ill, it is lessened.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Mars, source line 3
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter at natal Mars is said to produce gains from travel, trade, soldiers and relatives.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Sun, source line 4
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter at natal Sun is said to threaten fever while increasing honor or fame.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Venus, source line 5
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter at natal Venus is associated with sobriety and better reputation/property through women.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Mercury, source line 6
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter at natal Mercury is associated with study, religious or modest behavior and company of upright men.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Jupiter: returning to radix place Moon, source line 7
rules.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter at natal Moon is associated with health, patrimony, reputation, family and journeys and a child's birth.
source_conditional_qualifiers: The child-birth statement is expressly conditioned on the native being married.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Saturn, source line 1
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars at natal Saturn is associated with short journeys, delayed business, quarrels, possible facial injury and danger involving the father.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Jupiter, source line 2
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars at natal Jupiter is said to provide gains through relatives, clergy or large livestock.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Mars, source line 3
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars returning to its own natal place is associated with fire danger but also profit through soldiers or affectionate friendships.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Sun, source line 4
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars at natal Sun is associated with captivity, anger from powerful people, martial conflict or irritability.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Venus, source line 5
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars at natal Venus carries sexually moralizing allegations of excess and infidelity and purported disease risks.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Mercury, source line 6
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars at natal Mercury is associated with slanderous speech, deceit and danger arising from words.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mars: returning to radix place Moon, source line 7
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars at natal Moon is associated with drinking, repeated journeys and derogatory comments from women.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Saturn, source line 1
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at Saturn's natal place is associated with sexual desire but a moralized distinction in sexual conduct.
source_conditional_qualifiers: Source distinguishes weak Venus or sexual potency, not combust versus unfortunate; preserve these alternative conditions rather than a single outcome.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Jupiter, source line 2
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at natal Jupiter is associated with Jovian friendships, goods obtained through deaths, and visiting friends or relatives.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Mars, source line 3
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at natal Mars is associated with marriage or sexual behavior and gambling or sporting pursuits.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Sun, source line 4
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at natal Sun is said to bring worry and jealousy about a partner but potential fame or advancement.
source_conditional_qualifiers: The more favorable promotion/fame prediction is conditional on the natal Sun being dignified.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Venus, source line 5
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at its own natal place is described as successful and associated with music and health.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Mercury, source line 6
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at natal Mercury is associated with recognition for learning and benefit from learned companions.
source_conditional_qualifiers: Requires Venus to be well affected.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Venus: returning to radix place Moon, source line 7
rules.historical_meaning_only: Venus at natal Moon is said to improve the native's condition and favor with new acquaintances.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Saturn, source line 1
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at natal Saturn is said to bring agricultural profit or wealth from older men.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Jupiter, source line 2
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at natal Jupiter is said to bring office and gains by commerce and employment.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Mars, source line 3
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at natal Mars is ascribed theft, quarrels and conflict with soldiers.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Sun, source line 4
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at natal Sun is associated with disputes but honor through clerical or administrative work.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Venus, source line 5
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at natal Venus is linked with poetry, games, adornment, social life and courtship.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Mercury, source line 6
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at its own natal position is said to grant advancement through work or others' praise.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Mercury: returning to radix place Moon, source line 7
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury at natal Moon is associated with employment on friends' affairs and advantage from it.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Saturn, source line 1
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at natal Saturn is linked with acquaintance with an elderly woman, inheritance disputes and bad news concerning women.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Jupiter, source line 2
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at natal Jupiter is associated with profitable land and water travel and possible conception or childbirth.
source_conditional_qualifiers: The childbirth association is expressly conditional upon being married.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Mars, source line 3
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at natal Mars is said to bring illness or fever, anger, risky travel and disputes with women or relatives.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Sun, source line 4
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at natal Sun is associated with hazards, fleeing to another place and sore eyes.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Venus, source line 5
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at natal Venus is associated with pleasurable activities, health and contentment.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Mercury, source line 6
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at natal Mercury is said to bring frequent movements but gains in commerce.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Moon: returning to radix place Moon, source line 7
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon at its own natal place has favorable or unfavorable significance based on the natal Moon's prior condition.
source_conditional_qualifiers: If Moon was fortunate in the radix, the author predicts good; if weak at birth, the author predicts ill according to its natal signification.
